title: The structure of irreducible cuspidal eta quotients
summary: We show that an ir{\-}reducible cuspidal eta quotient of level~$N$ is uniquely identified by its orders of vanishing at $O((\log_2 N)^{r-1})$ cusps, where $r$ denotes the number of distinct prime divisors of $N$. In particular, all such eta quotients which are Fricke eigenforms of a prime power level, are uniquely identified only by their orders of vanishing at~$\infty$. We also prove that for all $k\in\N$, there exists a primitive and irreducible cuspidal eta quotient of weight $k/2$.
